je_pmr_dam_columbia_river_survey = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months add = 1 }
				debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_month|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveyed_any
		set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_columbia_river_claim days = 730 }
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_complete|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_columbia_river_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 30
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x3F0EE7 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_ended|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"

			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_months add = 1 }
				debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_month|segre_lower_ebro|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_surveyed_any
		set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_claim days = 730 }
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_complete|segre_lower_ebro|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 18
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x906040 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_surveying
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_segre_lower_ebro_surveying
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_ended|segre_lower_ebro|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_months add = 1 }
				debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_month|sulak_canyon|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_surveyed_any
		set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_claim days = 730 }
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_complete|sulak_canyon|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 18
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x3B6A9E ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_surveying
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_sulak_canyon_surveying
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_ended|sulak_canyon|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_months }

			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_months add = 1 }
				debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_month|onega_vyg|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_surveyed_any
		set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_claim days = 730 }
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_complete|onega_vyg|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_onega_vyg_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 18
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_months }
			NOT = {
				p:xA857F6 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_surveying
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_surveying
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_ended|onega_vyg|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	weight = 10

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -97648
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_columbia_river_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:x3F0EE7.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 18 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 19 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 17 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 18 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 16 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 17 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 15 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 16 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 14 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 15 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 13 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 14 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 12 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 13 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 11 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 12 } } }
			}
			else_if = {

				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 11 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 9 } } }

				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 8 } } }

				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 5 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 6 } } }
			}

				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 5 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 3 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 4 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 2 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 3 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 1 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_columbia_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 2 } } }
			}

			}
		}

		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier

			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 7 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 8 } } }
			}

				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 6 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 7 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 5 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 6 } } }

				create_building = { building = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 5 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 3 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 4 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 2 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_black_canyon_sierra  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 3 } } }
			}
			else_if = {

		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_rhone_isere_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -96446
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_rhone_isere_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_rhone_isere_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_rhone_isere_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:x7516B6.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_rhone_isere  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 5 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_rhone_isere  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 6 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_rhone_isere  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 4 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_rhone_isere  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 5 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_rhone_isere  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 3 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_rhone_isere  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 4 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_rhone_isere  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 2 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_rhone_isere  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 3 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_rhone_isere  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 1 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_rhone_isere  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 2 } } }
			}
			else = {
				create_building = { building = building_dam_rhone_isere  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_rhone_isere }
				pmr_dam_rhone_isere_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|rhone_isere|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_rhone_isere_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_rhone_isere_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 48
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_rhone_isere_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x7516B6 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_yalu_river_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_yalu_river_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:x47D537.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_yalu_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 2 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_yalu_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 3 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_yalu_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 1 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_yalu_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 2 } } }
			}
			else = {
				create_building = { building = building_dam_yalu_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_yalu_river }
				pmr_dam_yalu_river_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|yalu_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_yalu_river_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_yalu_river_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 41
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_yalu_river_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x47D537 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_yalu_river_fin_months }

je_pmr_dam_aura_nordland_finance = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -97584
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:x042C26.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { always = yes }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_aura_nordland  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_aura_nordland }
				pmr_dam_aura_nordland_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|aura_nordland|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_aura_nordland_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 52
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x042C26 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_fin_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_ended|aura_nordland|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

je_pmr_dam_tone_river_finance = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -95914
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_tone_river_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:x7090C0.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_tone_river  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 1 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_tone_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 2 } } }
			}
			else = {
				create_building = { building = building_dam_tone_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_tone_river }
				pmr_dam_tone_river_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|tone_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_tone_river_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 34
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x7090C0 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_fin_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_ended|tone_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

je_pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_finance = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -96234
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:xB24B12.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_chirchik_cascade  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 1 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_chirchik_cascade  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 2 } } }
			}
			else = {
				create_building = { building = building_dam_chirchik_cascade  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_chirchik_cascade }
				pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|chirchik_cascade|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 38
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:xB24B12 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_fin_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_chirchik_cascade_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_ended|chirchik_cascade|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

je_pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_finance = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -98057
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:x03A411.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { always = yes }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges }
				pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|bhagirathi_upper_ganges|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 46
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x03A411 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_fin_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_bhagirathi_upper_ganges_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_ended|bhagirathi_upper_ganges|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

je_pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_finance = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -98172
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:xF3EC53.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_garrison_missouri  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 1 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_garrison_missouri  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 2 } } }
			}
			else = {
				create_building = { building = building_dam_garrison_missouri  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_garrison_missouri }
				pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|garrison_missouri|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 45
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:xF3EC53 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_fin_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_garrison_missouri_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_ended|garrison_missouri|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no

				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_paulo_afonso_falls_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -97457
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_paulo_afonso_falls_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_paulo_afonso_falls_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_paulo_afonso_falls_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:xBAF5ED.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_paulo_afonso_falls  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 1 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_paulo_afonso_falls  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 2 } } }
			}
			else = {
				create_building = { building = building_dam_paulo_afonso_falls  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_paulo_afonso_falls }
				pmr_dam_paulo_afonso_falls_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|paulo_afonso_falls|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_paulo_afonso_falls_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_paulo_afonso_falls_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 40
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_paulo_afonso_falls_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:xBAF5ED ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_paulo_afonso_falls_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_paulo_afonso_falls_fin_months

je_pmr_dam_upper_ob_finance = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -97484
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_upper_ob_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:x875B76.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_upper_ob  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 1 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_upper_ob  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 2 } } }
			}
			else = {
				create_building = { building = building_dam_upper_ob  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_upper_ob }
				pmr_dam_upper_ob_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|upper_ob|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_upper_ob_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 38
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x875B76 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_fin_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_upper_ob_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_ended|upper_ob|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	weight = 10
	transferable = no

	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_niva_tuloma_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -98004
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_niva_tuloma_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_niva_tuloma_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_niva_tuloma_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:x96AD41.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { always = yes }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_niva_tuloma  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_niva_tuloma }
				pmr_dam_niva_tuloma_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|niva_tuloma|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_niva_tuloma_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_niva_tuloma_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 43
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_niva_tuloma_fin_months }

				p:x96AD41 ?= {
					state ?= {

							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_niva_tuloma_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_niva_tuloma_fin_months

				create_building = { building = building_dam_kremenchug_dnieper  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_kremenchug_dnieper }
				pmr_dam_kremenchug_dnieper_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|kremenchug_dnieper|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_kremenchug_dnieper_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_kremenchug_dnieper_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 30
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_kremenchug_dnieper_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x3ACCE8 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {

				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_savannah_river_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	}

		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_savannah_river_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier

			if = {
				limit = { always = yes }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_savannah_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_savannah_river }
				pmr_dam_savannah_river_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|savannah_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"

			value = root.var:pmr_dam_savannah_river_fin_months
		}
	}

		value = 43
	}

	invalid = {

							}
						}
					}

			}
		}

je_pmr_dam_first_cataract_finance = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -97812
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_first_cataract_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:xC48A06.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_first_cataract  levels_owned_by_country = { target = scope:pmr_dam_financier value >= 1 } } }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_first_cataract  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 2 } } }
			}
			else = {
				create_building = { building = building_dam_first_cataract  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_first_cataract }
				pmr_dam_first_cataract_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|first_cataract|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_first_cataract_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 30
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:xC48A06 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_fin_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_first_cataract_financing

		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_ended|first_cataract|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"

		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|rincon_del_bonete|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_rincon_del_bonete_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_rincon_del_bonete_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 24
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_rincon_del_bonete_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x3D3A57 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_rincon_del_bonete_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_rincon_del_bonete_fin_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_rincon_del_bonete_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_ended|rincon_del_bonete|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

je_pmr_dam_uhl_river_finance = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_uhl_river_fin_months }
				add_treasury = -91898
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_uhl_river_fin_months add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_uhl_river_fin_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_uhl_river_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		save_scope_as = pmr_dam_financier
		p:x3264B7.state = {
			if = {
				limit = { always = yes }
				create_building = { building = building_dam_uhl_river  add_ownership = { country = { country = scope:pmr_dam_financier levels = 1 } } }
			}
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_uhl_river }
				pmr_dam_uhl_river_on_level = yes
			}
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_done|uhl_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_uhl_river_fin_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_uhl_river_fin_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 11
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_uhl_river_fin_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x3264B7 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_uhl_river_fin_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_uhl_river_fin_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_uhl_river_financing
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_financing add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|finance_ended|uhl_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}
